name: marketops
description: MarketOps business workflow Skill — routes market, pool, follow-up, draft and diagnostics requests to the MarketOps MCP server, which is the only source of business facts.

interface.shortDescription: Find and contact organisations in a market
interface.longDescription: The canonical MarketOps Skill. It holds no business fact of its own: every account, count, budget and permission it reports is read from the MarketOps MCP server at the moment of use. It decides which server use case a request belongs to and how to present what comes back.
defaultPrompt: Continue the last market and add more accounts of the same kind.
What changed in this pool since I last looked?
Draft something for this organisation and show me what it rests on.
